name: Personal data
description: Personal data the way the law of your market wants it: a cookie banner that holds counters and pixels back until the visitor agrees, Google Consent Mode, a record of every consent, how long IP addresses are kept, and a customer's own data — downloaded or erased on request. Presets for the EU, the US, Russia and Ukraine.

settings.label: Whose law
settings.help: Fills in the settings below the way that law asks; change any of them afterwards. Set on Personal data → Settings.

options.opt_in: Ask first — nothing but the necessary until the visitor agrees
options.opt_out: Allowed until the visitor says no

settings.label: Privacy policy page
settings.help: An address on this site, e.g. /privacy. Linked from the banner and from the consent boxes.

settings.label: Consent to processing (a separate document)
settings.help: Russia asks for the consent as a document of its own since 1 September 2025. Empty — not linked.

settings.label: Honour the browser's Global Privacy Control
settings.help: A browser that sends it has said no to selling or sharing — advertising code waits as if the visitor had refused.

settings.label: Google Consent Mode v2
settings.help: Tells Google tags what the visitor allowed. Without it Google stops building remarketing audiences from visitors in the EU.

settings.label: Answer a request within, days
settings.help: The deadline shown on a customer's request to download or erase their data.

permissions.name: privacy.manage
permissions.label: Manage personal data: settings, requests, consents
